en.headline: Election Committee turnout reaches 89.81 per cent by 1pm
en.dek: A total of 5,127 voters have cast ballots out of 5,709 eligible electors as of 1pm on Sunday, according to official figures.
body: The Registration and Electoral Office said the cumulative turnout for the Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections reached 89.81 per cent by 1pm on Sunday, with 5,127 people having voted out of 5,709 eligible electors.
This is higher than the 69.61 per cent recorded at 11am and the 83.03 per cent at noon. Polling opened at 9am and is scheduled to close at 6pm.
Some subsectors reported turnout rates of 100 per cent by early afternoon. Officials earlier said operations at polling stations were running smoothly, with no complaints received by late morning.
The elected members will join other members to form the 1,500-strong Election Committee responsible for nominating and electing the Chief Executive.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉截至下午1時投票率89.81%
zh.dek: 選舉事務處公布，截至周日下午1時，5709名合資格投票人中已有5127人投票，累積投票率達89.81%。
body: 選舉事務處表示，選委會界別分組一般選舉截至周日下午1時的累積投票率為89.81%，5709名合資格投票人中有5127人已投票。
數字高於上午11時的69.61%及中午12時的83.03%。投票由上午9時開始，至下午6時結束。
部分界別分組在下午初段已錄得百分之百投票率。官員較早時表示票站運作暢順，上午暫未接獲投訴。
當選委員將與其他成員組成1500人的選舉委員會，負責提名及選出行政長官。
